rows.text: copies the 8-byte entry at sign-extended word `rdx+0xA` of qword `rdx+0x20` into a local as words `+0`, `+2`, word `+4` AND 0xFFF and (dword `+4` shifted right 12) AND 0xFFF; when the fifth (stack) argument is 0 it pairs `r8w`, `r9w` with words `rdx+0x10`, `rdx+0x12` unchanged, otherwise it sets `r8w` = sixth + ((`r8d` - sixth) * fifth >> 8), `r9w` = seventh + ((`r9d` - seventh) * fifth >> 8) and replaces both words with (word * fifth) >> 8; stores at `rcx+0x5C` the low nibble of byte `rdx+0x39` plus the byte at (high nibble + word `+0x12`) of the block at qword `+0x20` of qword `rdx+0x18` plus 0x30; then calls (`00366A30` + 0x13B) with `rcx`, qword `rdx+0x18`, the local entry, the four local words, a local holding dword 0, 0.0 and pointer `rdx+0x28`, and 1.0 (`01CEBBA8`)
indexes the 0x90-stride table `02ADBB40` by the low byte of `ecx` and returns that entry's float `+8` when `ecx` is non-zero and the entry's dword `+0` equals `ecx`; otherwise returns 0.0

works on the qword array pointed to by `02EBEF78`: when `ecx` is non-zero it uses slot `ecx` (sign-extended) and, if that slot is non-null, passes it to the call at `003A9AD0` + 0x3B and clears it; when `ecx` is 0 it scans slots 1 to 0x2FF for the first null one and returns 0 if there is none; it then calls (`003A9AD0` + 0x59) with `r8d` and returns 0 when that returns null, otherwise stores `dl` at byte `+0x44` and the slot index at word `+0x42` of the result, writes the result into the slot and returns it
makes the same call three times with `edx` unchanged, on `rcx`, `rcx+0x10` and `rcx+0x20` (sites `004FE4A0` + 0xF, + 0x1A and + 0x25), and returns `rcx+0x80`

reads byte `+0xC2` of qword `rcx+0xE0` and tail-jumps with `rcx` and `rdx` unchanged: values 0, 2 and 3 all go to one target (the jumps at `004FF1B0` + 0x35, + 0x2B and + 0x26) and value 1 to another (`004FF1B0` + 0x30); any other value returns without a jump

reads byte `+0xC2` of qword `rcx+0xE0` and tail-jumps with `rcx` and `rdx` unchanged: value 0 through the jump at `004FF1F0` + 0x35, value 1 through `004FF1F0` + 0x30, values 2 and 3 to one shared target (`004FF1F0` + 0x2B and + 0x26); any other value returns without a jump
makes the same call three times with `edx` unchanged, on `rcx`, `rcx+0x40` and `rcx+0x80` (sites `004FF230` + 0xF, + 0x1A and + 0x28), and returns `rcx+0xD0`

returns 0xFFFF when `cx` is -1; otherwise forms qword `022C6F28` + sign-extended `cx` * 0x740 and returns 0xFFFF when that sum is zero or its dword `+0x284` is 0, else tail-jumps (`00524790` + 0x29) with `rcx` set to that address

clears bit 31 of dword `rcx+0x18`; when the result is above 1 (unsigned) it returns qword `rcx+0x20` + `edx` * 0x10 + 0xC, when it is 1 it returns `rcx+0x20` + `edx` * 0x10 + 0xC, and when it is 0 it returns `edx` * 0x10 + 0xC on a null base

notes: 00366A30: the stack arguments are read at [rsp+0x80/0x88/0x90] after push+sub 0x58, i.e. the fifth, sixth and seventh arguments; the interpolation adds are 16-bit (r8w/r9w). 004FF1B0/004FF1F0: targets are cited by their jump sites, not by address; 'returns' on the default path leaves rax = qword rcx+0xE0. 00524790: the zero test is the je after the add (ZF of the sum).
